question: PKL legend Pardeep Narwal retires at 28. Which team did Pardeep Narwal lead to three consecutive PKL titles?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Patna Pirates**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• PKL legend Pardeep Narwal retires at 28.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Pardeep Narwal**, the **most successful raider** in Pro Kabaddi League (PKL) history, has **retired** after **unsold in the PKL Season 12 auction**.

 
 
• 
 
He made the announcement at age **28.**

 
 
• 
 
Narwal will now **transition to coaching**.

 
 
• 
 
Career achievements:

 
 
• 
 
**1801 raid points** (all-time highest in PKL).

 
 
• 
 
**Average:** 9.47 raid points per match.

 
 
• 
 
**Led Patna Pirates** to **three consecutive PKL titles**.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
Later played for **UP Yoddhas** and **Bengaluru Bulls.**
